verses.text: Whoever stays stubborn after being corrected many times will suddenly be destroyed, and nothing can save them.
When good people do well, the people celebrate, but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
A man who loves wisdom makes his father glad, but a man who spends time with prostitutes wastes his wealth.
A king makes his country strong by being fair, but one who demands bribes tears it down.
Whoever flatters their neighbour is spreading a net for their feet.
Evil people are trapped by their own sin, but good people can sing and be glad.
Good people care about justice for the poor, but the wicked do not care at all.
Mockers stir up a city, but wise people calm down anger.
If a wise person takes a fool to court, the fool shouts and laughs, and there is no peace.
Murderers hate people who are honest and try to kill those who do right.
Fools let all their anger out, but wise people keep themselves under control.
If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials become wicked.
Poor people and those who crush them have this in common: the LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.
If a king judges the poor fairly, his throne will be secure forever.
Discipline and correction bring wisdom, but a child left to do whatever he wants brings shame to his mother.
When the wicked grow in number, sin grows too, but good people will see them fall.
Discipline your children, and they will give you peace. They will bring you delight.
Where there is no message from God, people run wild, but happy are those who keep the law.
Words alone will not correct a servant. Even if he understands, he will not respond.
Do you see someone who speaks too quickly? There is more hope for a fool than for them.
If you spoil your servant from childhood, in the end he will think he is your son.
An angry person stirs up fights, and a hot-tempered person commits many sins.
Pride brings a person down, but a humble spirit gains honour.
Whoever helps a thief hurts themselves. They are put under oath, but they dare not say anything.
Fear of people is a trap, but whoever trusts in the LORD is kept safe.
Many people want the ruler's favour, but justice for people comes from the LORD.
Good people hate those who are dishonest, and the wicked hate those who live honestly.
